descriptions.counterfactual: Two identical boat-shaped rattlebacks with identical fixed diagonal brass weights stand side by side on separate solid tables, tilted equally on retractable supports. Both supports withdraw together, releasing the same initial rocking. The left reference boat develops rotation, but the right boat develops rotation in the opposite direction despite its identical shape, weights, orientation and release; only its rocking-to-spin coupling is reversed.
